column1: NATIONAL  WATER  SUPPLY  AND  DRAINAGE  BOARD  ACT,  No. 02 OF  1974
BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of
1974, I, Rauff  Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, do hereby approve the acquisition
of the immovable  properties of the land described  in the following Schedule as the land is required by the said Board, for
construction of Jayasinghegama Main Water Tank under Atampitiya Water Supply Project.
